description: List the taxa this one is most often misidentified as, ranked by how many times identifiers made the correction — the field-identification check before committing to a look-alike. Scope it to an area in exactly one form (place_id, the lat/lng/radius triple in kilometres, or a four-corner bounding box) to see the confusion set a specific region actually produces, or leave the area off for the global set. The taxon must be a genus or finer (genus, species, or below) — upstream keeps no confusion set for a family, order, or anything coarser. Resolve the organism name to a taxon id with inaturalist_resolve_name first.

captive.description: Whether to include captive and cultivated records — zoo animals, garden plantings. Defaults to wild organisms only.

d1.description: Earliest observation date, YYYY-MM-DD. Inclusive. Must be on or before d2.

lat.description: Latitude of the search centre, in decimal degrees. Requires lng and radius.

limit.description: Maximum look-alikes to return. Applied in-process — the upstream endpoint publishes no page size and returns its whole confusion set.

lng.description: Longitude of the search centre, in decimal degrees. Requires lat and radius.

nelat.description: North-east corner latitude of the bounding box, at or north of swlat. All four corners or none.

nelng.description: North-east corner longitude of the bounding box. All four corners or none. West of swlng is accepted: it describes a box crossing the antimeridian.

place_id.description: Numeric iNaturalist place id from inaturalist_find_places. Mutually exclusive with the lat/lng/radius triple and the bounding box. A non-numeric value answers HTTP 500 upstream.

quality_grade.description: Identification confidence tiers to include. Defaults to research-grade only; adding "needs_id" roughly doubles the corpus and lowers identification confidence.

radius.description: Search radius around lat/lng, in KILOMETRES, greater than 0. Requires lat and lng. The upstream publishes no bound; 500 is a verified ceiling this server imposes.

swlat.description: South-west corner latitude of the bounding box. All four corners or none.

swlng.description: South-west corner longitude of the bounding box. All four corners or none.

taxon_id.description: Numeric taxon id to find look-alikes for, at genus or finer — a genus, species, or subspecies; a family or anything coarser is refused. Resolve a name to an id with inaturalist_resolve_name.

name: inaturalist_get_similar_species

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_geography`: An area was given partially, in two forms at once, with a radius of 0 or less, or with nelat south of swlat. `inverted_date_range`: d1 is after d2. `unknown_taxon_id`: iNaturalist answered 422 because the taxon_id does not exist. `taxon_rank_too_coarse`: iNaturalist answered 422 because the taxon is coarser than genus, such as a family, order, or class. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when no look-alikes are recorded, or when the limit cut the set.

shown.description: How many look-alikes this response carries.

similar_species.description: Look-alikes ranked by misidentification_count, most-confused first.

items.description: One look-alike and how often it is confused with the queried taxon.

common_name.description: Preferred common name, when one is recorded.

misidentification_count.description: How many times identifiers corrected this taxon to the queried one. The ranking key.

observations_count.description: How many observations this look-alike has overall. Null when upstream published none.

photo.description: Representative photo, when the taxon carries one.

attribution.description: Attribution string, verbatim and never reformatted. Reproduce it with any use of the image.

license_code.description: Photo licence code. Null means all rights reserved, independent of the record.

medium_url.description: Medium variant. Supplied by upstream where it publishes every size, otherwise derived by substituting the size qualifier in the path. Absent when the path did not match the documented shape.

open.description: True when the photo is served from the host the upstream reserves for open licences. A photo can move hosts when its licence changes, so this reflects fetch time.

square_url.description: 75px square variant, exactly as upstream published it. Null when absent.

taxon_id.description: Taxon id of the look-alike — pass it to inaturalist_get_taxon for its profile.
The taxon the look-alikes were found for.

totalCount.description: How many look-alikes upstream returned, before the limit was applied.

truncated.description: True when the limit cut the confusion set.

truncationCeiling.description: Misidentification count of the last look-alike shown. The ranking is descending, so no omitted look-alike exceeds it.

title: Inaturalist Get Similar Species
